mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ai_session (session_id, agent_id, title, message_count, status, model_id, preview, created_at, updated_at, last_message_at) VALUES (#{sessionId}, #{agentId}, #{title}, #{messageCount}, 1, #{modelId}, #{preview}, NOW(), NOW(), NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE ai_session SET title=#{title}, message_count=#{messageCount}, updated_at=NOW() WHERE session_id=#{sessionId}
UPDATE ai_session SET title=#{title}, updated_at=NOW() WHERE session_id=#{sessionId} AND status=1
UPDATE ai_session SET status=0, updated_at=NOW() WHERE session_id=#{sessionId} AND status=1
UPDATE ai_session SET message_count=message_count+1, updated_at=NOW() WHERE session_id=#{sessionId}

UPDATE ai_session SET message_count=message_count+1, updated_at=NOW(), last_message_at=NOW(), preview=#{preview}, title=CASE WHEN title IS NULL OR title='' OR title IN ('新对话','New chat','New Chat') THEN LEFT(TRIM(#{preview}), 5) ELSE title END, model_id=CASE WHEN #{modelId}='' THEN model_id ELSE #{modelId} END WHERE session_id=#{sessionId}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM ai_session WHERE session_id=#{sessionId} AND status=1
SELECT * FROM ai_session WHERE agent_id=#{agentId} AND session_id=#{sessionId} AND status=1

SELECT s.*, CASE WHEN s.title IS NULL OR s.title='' OR s.title IN ('新对话','New chat','New Chat') THEN COALESCE(( SELECT LEFT(TRIM(m.content), 5) FROM chat_message m WHERE m.session_id=s.session_id AND m.role='user' ORDER BY m.id ASC LIMIT 1 ), s.title) ELSE s.title END AS title FROM ai_session s WHERE s.agent_id=#{agentId} AND s.status=1 ORDER BY COALESCE(s.last_message_at,s.updated_at) DESC LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT * FROM ai_session WHERE status=1 ORDER BY updated_at DESC LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ai_session WHERE agent_id=#{agentId} AND status=1
